description:
Start downloading Garmin data into the local cache. Runs in the background and returns immediately; follow progress with garmin_sync_status.

You rarely need this: other tools sync automatically on first use and when the cache is over an hour old. Use it to:
  - fetch the latest data right now (e.g. "I just finished a run"),
  - extend history further back (from="2019-01-01"),
  - re-download everything (mode="full"), e.g. after editing many activities in Garmin Connect.

Domains (default: all except fit_files): activities, daily_summaries, sleep, hrv, weight, body_battery, hrv_readings, heart_rate, spo2.
"fit_files" downloads the original FIT file of every activity (one request each, ~2 activities/s). That's optional: FIT files are otherwise fetched on demand by garmin_get_activity_laps and garmin_get_activity_streams.

domains.description: Only sync these domains. Defaults to all except "fit_files".

from.description: Extend history back to this date (yyyy-MM-dd). History starts at your first activity by default; an earlier date fetches older wellness data. A later date has no effect: history is never narrowed.

mode.description: auto: new data plus any history still missing. full: forget what's cached and re-download.

name: garmin_sync
title: Sync Garmin data
